notes: New in 4.1.1: a channel no longer starts, stops and starts again on a TV stick. Interlaced channels stay behind the loading circle until the picture really runs, about 3 s on sticks whose decoder stumbles on them. Also tidier code for the freeze checks, with tests.
notes_en: New in 4.1.1: a channel no longer starts, stops and starts again on a TV stick. Interlaced channels stay behind the loading circle until the picture really runs, about 3 s on sticks whose decoder stumbles on them. Also tidier code for the freeze checks, with tests.
notes_sq: E re në 4.1.1: kanali nuk nis, ndalet dhe nis përsëri në TV stick. Kanalet interlaced qëndrojnë pas rrethit të ngarkimit derisa fotoja të luajë vërtet, rreth 3 s në stick-et ku dekoderi ngec me to. Gjithashtu kod më i rregullt dhe me teste për kontrollin e ngrirjeve.
